name: Scoop
text:
Decision: We should **publish a daily “AI-News Flash” email** that curates the newest official announcements (government white-papers, corporate press releases, standards bodies) within 24 hours of release, sorted by topic and urgency.

Why it’s best: Speed beats completeness when the goal is freshness. A tight daily digest keeps readers ahead of the curve without drowning them in noise, and the 24-hour window is short enough to feel “new” yet long enough to catch most official drops.

Trade-off we accept: Depth for timeliness. We’ll skip deep analysis and long reads to hit the deadline, trusting that readers can chase the links if they want more.
